sql_calls.sql:
WITH upi_attempts AS (
    SELECT bill_id, attempt, tender, till_status, ts,
           ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY bill_id ORDER BY attempt) as rn
    FROM payments.pos_payments
    WHERE tender = 'UPI'
      AND ts >= '2026-06-01' AND ts < '2026-07-01'
)
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT a1.bill_id) as retry_count
FROM upi_attempts a1
JOIN upi_attempts a2 ON a1.bill_id = a2.bill_id AND a2.rn = a1.rn + 1
WHERE a1.till_status = 'declined'
  AND a2.tender = 'UPI';
